categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The categories steer the triage: the AI reads the description, the tier decides what happens with a mail of that kind.
categories.name: Name
categories.descriptionHint: Goes into the prompt verbatim. The clearer it says when the category applies, the surer the AI gets.
categories.deleteMessage: Really delete the category “{{name}}”? Its description steers the classification, so future mail will be sorted differently.
categories.deleteBlockedDetail: “{{name}}” is assigned to {{count}} cases. Reassign them first, or set the category inactive.
categories.descriptionRequired: Please enter a description — without one the AI cannot place the category.
categories.duplicate: A category with this name already exists.
categories.lastActive: The last active category cannot be removed — the AI would stop sorting anything.
categories.loadError: Could not load the categories. Is the backend running?
categories.thresholdHint: Below this the case drops one tier — rather one draft too many than a wrong automatic answer.
categories.instructionsHint: Appended to the prompt, for this company’s peculiarities. For example: "mail from @supplier-xy.example is always an order confirmation".
categories.replyInstructionsHint: What the replies should sound like: form of address, tone, what never to promise. For example: "address customers formally; never promise delivery dates".
